schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
schemes.description: Income support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families.
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits.description: Financial assistance provided to eligible farmer families.

application.description: Application and beneficiary services are available through the official PM-KISAN portal.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
schemes.description: Housing assistance scheme for eligible rural households that meet the prescribed criteria.

benefits.description: Financial assistance for construction of a pucca house for eligible rural households.

application.description: Implementation and beneficiary identification are carried out through the prescribed government process.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
schemes.description: Scholarship support for eligible students belonging to specified categories and meeting applicable income and educational conditions.

benefits.description: Financial support for eligible post-matric students.

application.description: Eligible students can apply through the National Scholarship Portal where the relevant scheme is available.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
